newsitem.title: USA: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-JETS ROUND UP OTHER FORMER PATRIOT COACHES TO COMPLETE STAFF.
newsitem.headline: NFL AMERICAN FOOTBALL-JETS ROUND UP OTHER FORMER PATRIOT COACHES TO COMPLETE STAFF.

text.p: The New York Jets, on hold over the immediate future of Bill Parcells, sprang into action Thursday and rounded up five assistants from his Patriots' days to fill out their staff for the 1997 season.
Bill Belichick, the Jets coach in 1997 unless an agreement is reached with New England to allow Parcells to coach, also retained three coaches from Rich Kotite's staff last season.
Al Groh, Romeo Crennel, Maurice Carthon, Charlie Weis and Mike Sweatman all worked with Parcells and Belichick, Parcell's assistant last season in New England, in leading the Pats to the Super Bowl.

Ron Erhardt, Pat Hodgson and Bill Muir were retained as Jet coaches and Eric Mangini, an offensive coach for the Baltimore Ravens last season, was also added to the staff by Belichick. Specific assignments will be announced next week.
The Jets also named Baltimore personnel coordinator Scott Pioli as director of pro personnel.
The Ravens were formerly the Cleveland Browns, which Belichick steered as head coach for five years before rejoining Parcells in Foxboro.

The status of Parcells is up in the air pending a review by NFL Commissioner Paul Tagliabue into his hiring by the Jets as a consultant. Parcells, who announced last week he would not return to coach New England, is barred from taking a coaching or general manager's position in the NFL without permission from the Patriots.
Groh was defensive coordinator and linebackers coach for Parcells in his four years with the Pat. Prior to joining the Patriots, Groh coached the linebackers on Belichick's Browns staff in 1992.
Crennel was the defensive line coach for Parcells in his four years with the Patriots.
Carthon just completed his third year as running backs coach with the Patriots. He was a blocking fullback for Parcells' two Super Bowl championship teams with the New York Giants in 1986 and 1990.
Weis was also a coach for all of Parcells' four seasons in New England, serving as tight ends coach the first two years, running backs coach in 1995, and receivers coach in 1996.
Sweatman was special teams coach for Parcells in New England.
All the former Pats' coaches brought over had ties to Parcells dating back to his Giants days.

Erhardt was the offensive coordinator and quarterbacks coach for the Jets last season and will likely serve in that role again. He was the offensive coordinator under Parcells with the Giants from 1982 to 1990.
Hodgson was the Jets tight ends coach and Bill Muir was the offensive line coach under Kotite.
The 25-year-old Mangini just completed his first year as quality control coach of the offence with the Ravens.
Pioli was responsible for contract negotiating and salary cap maintenance with the Ravens last year.
